title: Keating-Snaith Conjecture on Moments of the Riemann Zeta Function
exact_target: Do all positive real moments of the zeta function on its central line have the precise leading asymptotic predicted by the arithmetic product and random-matrix factor?

sources.citation: J. P. Keating and N. C. Snaith, "Random Matrix Theory and zeta(1/2+it)," Communications in Mathematical Physics 214 (2000), 57-89.
